Package edu.secourse.model

Class User

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.model.User
Direct Known Subclasses:
Admin, Customer, Stylist
public class User extends Object
Represents a system user with authentication and profile information.

This class provides functionality for:

  • Automatic generation of a unique account identifier
  • Secure password storage using BCrypt hashing
  • Password validation and update mechanisms
  • Tracking user metadata such as last login time

Passwords are never stored in plaintext. All passwords are hashed using the BCrypt algorithm before storage, ensuring secure authentication practices.

A password change flag is included to enforce password updates (e.g., after initial account creation or administrative reset).

Note: This class is designed for non-Spring environments and uses in-memory account number generation via AtomicInteger.

    • User

      public User()

    • User

      public User(String username, String password, String name, String email, String role)
      Constructs a new User with the specified attributes.

      The account ID is automatically generated, and the provided password is hashed using BCrypt. The user is required to change their password upon first login.

      Parameters:
      username - the username for authentication
      password - the plaintext password (will be hashed)
      name - the full name of the user
      email - the user's email address
      role - the role assigned to the user
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the password is null or blank

    • changePassword

      public void changePassword(String oldPassword, String newPassword)
      Changes the user's password after validating the current password.

      This method enforces:

      • Correct current password
      • Non-empty new password
      • New password must differ from the old password

      Upon successful change, the mustChangePassword flag is cleared.

      Parameters:
      oldPassword - the current plaintext password
      newPassword - the new plaintext password
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if validation fails
